title: Chapter 67 — Portfolio Expansion: Growing Property Accounts
intro: Building-by-building penetration and the management-firm ladder.

sections.title: Building by Building
sections.content:
Property managers manage portfolios — multiple buildings, each with dozens or hundreds of units. Start with one building. Prove service and pricing. Then expand to additional properties.

The management-firm ladder: start with one property manager, grow to the regional office, then the corporate account.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating portfolio expansion, ask:

Is the salesperson growing property accounts building by building?
Are they pursuing the management-firm hierarchy — or stuck at one contact?
